notes: Canonical roster of agent directories under agents/. Every subdirectory must appear here exactly once; every entry must correspond to an existing subdirectory. See tests/test_agent_registry.py. Retired overlapping agent directories may be retained for history and must be registered with status=deprecated and merged_into pointing at the canonical agent.

bioshort_watch.role: suppressed LLM hedge-governance consumer; B2 dashboard covers use case
bioshort_watch.notes: LLM agent suppressed 2026-05-06 (bioshort upstream P2). B2 dashboard freshness badge (3d/7d thresholds) provides equivalent visibility. Reactivation requires operator decision and separate spec. Deterministic producer/status tooling remains outside OpenClaw workspace. Sunset review scheduled 2026-09-30.

calibration_evidence.role: read-only evidence builder on resolved events
calibration_evidence.notes: Shares artifact path with calibration; downstream consumer.

catalyst_delta.role: detect new, changed, or reclassified catalyst events
catalyst_delta.notes: Crontab: 18:20. LLM elevation rule narrowed 2026-05-06 (P1 #2, partial closure — LLM-side only): narrative names only deltas where ticker is in-universe AND catalyst_days<=60 AND change-code is HARD or family-changing; suppressed deltas are rollup-summarized, not erased. Deterministic artifact tools/build_catalyst_delta.py and downstream consumer tools/build_options_watch.py UNCHANGED — the raw artifact remains the source of truth. catalyst_delta_score scoring field (module_3_scoring*.py, module_5_composite.py) UNCHANGED. Artifact-level filtering deferred to a separate explicit change with before/after artifact diffs.

crt_resolution_watcher.role: monitor for new CRT resolutions, update join tables

ctgov_poller.role: clinical trial status monitor, detect transitions

data_auditor.role: read-only judge monitoring data input integrity
data_auditor.notes: Daily integrity audit runs via agents/data_auditor/run_audit.py and tools/cron_data_auditor.sh; heartbeat verifies artifacts/data_auditor integrity reports.

earnings_calendar_sync.role: fetch and keep work calendar in sync with earnings

event_analyst.notes: Weekly Friday cadence (P1 #4 reduction landed 2026-05-06). LLM agent fires Fri 18:55 ET; deterministic builder fires Fri 19:10 ET. Was previously daily Mon-Fri (both entries); reduced to Friday-only after ROI/noise audit. Watchdog event_analyst auto-recovery removed in the same change to prevent re-firing on Mon-Thu. Manual invocation path preserved: tools/run_agent_direct.py --agent event_analyst, tools/build_event_analyst.py --as-of-date YYYY-MM-DD.

fleet_steward.role: control-plane agent, fleet health and dispatch
fleet_steward.notes: Director role. Deterministic fleet receipts restored via tools/agent_heartbeat_checks.py and written to agents/fleet_steward/memory/.

herald.role: biotech news collection, classification, and digests
herald.notes: Canonical news pipeline: fetch/dedupe/classify (tools/fetch_company_press_releases.py, dedupe, classify) + 3x daily digest (scripts/build_news_digest.py). Absorbs company_news_ingest and biotech_news_digest (Fix #5 2026-05-30). Crontab: 14:35 premarket fetch; digest windows via build_news_digest cron.

hermes-first-fire-validator.role: validate first-fire readiness before production promotion
hermes-first-fire-validator.notes: Spec 089 Phase 2. Hermes job: one-shot after new cron first run. Entry: agents/hermes-first-fire-validator/run_job.py. Reads artifacts/ops/first_fire_ledger/latest.json.

hermes-held-spec-ledger.role: held-spec ledger analyst, route operator alerts
hermes-held-spec-ledger.notes: Spec 089/090 Phase 2. Mon 08:45 ET + daily while specs open. Entry: agents/hermes-held-spec-ledger/run_job.py.

hermes-ruleset-integrity.role: ruleset integrity monitor, CLAUDE.md vs runtime
